basics.name: Mason Jeffers
basics.label: Engineer
basics.summary: Mechanical engineer with experience in distributed control systems and defense industry design. Skilled in 3D design, CNC manufacturing, and robotic systems integration.

work.name: Siemens
work.summary: Industrial automation engineer specializing in Siemens PCS7 distributed control systems for manufacturing and process automation. Design, configure, and maintain enterprise-grade control systems with focus on reliability, safety, and performance.
highlights: Configure and program Siemens PCS7 DCS for industrial process control and automation
Develop SCADA/HMI operator interfaces for real-time monitoring and control
Implement SIL-rated safety control logic for critical manufacturing processes
Design and troubleshoot industrial communication networks (Profibus, Profinet, Modbus)
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (mechanical, electrical, software) on automation projects
Apply deterministic real-time control principles from DCS engineering to robotics research

work.name: SCI Technology
work.summary: Mechanical engineer for defense unmanned systems. Designed drone components and subsystems with focus on manufacturability, integration, and performance in operational environments.
highlights: Designed mechanical components and assemblies for defense drone platforms
Created 3D CAD models and technical drawings for CNC manufacturing
Collaborated with cross-functional teams on system integration and testing
Supported prototype builds and iterative design improvements

projects.name: Industrial Robot Arm Restoration & ROS Integration
projects.summary: Restored and integrated a Mitsubishi RV-6SDL-S15 6-axis industrial robot with ROS for advanced automation R&D. Complete mechanical refurbishment, controller reverse engineering, and custom software development.
highlights: Mechanical restoration: Rebuilt J2 harmonic drive, AC servo motors, and all 6 axes
Communication: Developed Python interface for Ethernet (Modbus/TCP) and RS-232 control
Integration: RT Toolbox2 for MELFA BASIC programming and real-time telemetry
Architecture: Designed modular control system with error handling and state management

projects.name: Homelab Infrastructure
projects.summary: Proxmox-based virtualization server for development, testing, and automation experimentation.
highlights: Self-hosted development environment for automation projects
